name: airec
description: Record Windows screen evidence of an agent's work with the airec CLI and convert it to GIF.

interface.shortDescription: Record Windows screen evidence of agent work
interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent to record its own Windows computer-use work as MP4 with the airec CLI, check the session state and stop reason, and convert the recording to GIF for pull requests.
defaultPrompt: Record the window you are about to work in with airec and attach the GIF as evidence
